pages.title: Binding source first
pages.text: Every machine that writes products or FE to personal Xianqiao storage uses the persistent ImmortalStorage identity, never the placer, nearest player, or the launcher's current session UUID. Inside a player's own personal realm, the realm owner wins; outside a personal realm, only an owned Spirit Drive with an online owner can provide binding; otherwise the machine is bound to nobody.

The ordinary Immortal Furnace's automatic Immortal Yuan refill reads the owner of the current personal realm. A Spirit Drive is reusable payment authorization: it charges Immortal Yuan from its owner and then True Yuan if needed. The Simulated Spirit Field and Simulated Reincarnation Furnace use the same realm-first, Spirit-Drive-fallback rule; directly inserted True Yuan or Immortal Yuan is consumed as the item fuel.

The Simulated Spirit Field and Simulated Reincarnation Furnace have two independent switches. Xianqiao Output decides whether completed products are committed first to the bound player's Xianqiao; Automatic Output decides whether the machine's local buffer may interact through enabled faces. Turning one off never silently changes the other. Without a binding, products remain in the local output slots.

The Xianeng Electricity Crystal follows the same binding priority and has an 800,000,000 FE default capacity. Xianqiao Output can be enabled only when a binding and an available stage-eight external FE container exist. Enabling it flushes local FE to Xianqiao and changes the FE capability to that ledger. Closing it detaches the ledger and resumes from the zeroed local cache; Xianqiao FE is not pulled back. Closing Xianqiao Output stops only the realm's automatic Immortal Yuan refill when the fuel slot is empty; a Spirit Drive placed in the fuel slot keeps its replacement-fuel path active.

The Xianeng Electricity Crystal is the FE instance of this resource-machine family; see Xianeng Electricity Crystal Behavior in the Automation category for its slots, charging, face rules, cache priority, and long-valued interaction. This chapter keeps the general machine binding/output rules; Xianeng Mana Crystal, Xianeng Source Crystal, and their Botania/Ars Nouveau rules are gathered in Crystal Integrations under Mod Integration.

Every optional crystal capability is isolated behind its integration boundary: the Mana Crystal is absent without Botania, and the Source Crystal is absent without Ars Nouveau. The Electricity Crystal always declares FE; use Crystal Integrations for optional capabilities, processing items, face targets, and family recipes.

For the Electricity Crystal, Xianqiao Output requires a binding and a stage-eight external FE endpoint; enabling it writes local FE to the owner's Xianqiao and leaves the local cache at zero, while closing only detaches and resumes local caching from zero. Automatic Output controls active six-face pushes only; the extra slot never enters Xianqiao and is bottom-extract-only.

The Electricity Crystal's processing slot receives from above, its four horizontal sides accept fuel only, and the bottom accepts no input. It processes a complete item stack one item at a time; processing/charging has priority over six-face resource output, with remaining resources offered to Xianqiao afterward. It generates 1,000 FE per tick by default, stores 800,000,000 FE by default, and exposes long-valued AE2/RS access as detailed in Xianeng Electricity Crystal Behavior.

A plain or Advanced Xianqiao Interface binds once when placed by a stage-six-or-later player. Passive capabilities, active Pull/Push, and the six-face masks are separate: passive pipe access is not the scheduler's active output. Clearing, retargeting, or breaking a cache first returns it to Xianqiao; only un-placeable remainder stays in compact dropped data. The Advanced Interface applies the same rule to a configurable box with polling, split, and distance ordering.

Each Source Vein has its own owner and real cache; six-face PUSH and standard capabilities read that cache only. A Source Vein Manager can be claimed only inside its owner's Xianqiao, aggregates an extraction view, and never takes ownership of member caches. Source Vein Immortal Yuan charging/prepayment remains active; non-source FE, Mana, Source, and similar external namespaces no longer convert Immortal Yuan into resources.

The World Shard Miner stores an immutable placer-owner snapshot: in that owner's personal realm a complete cycle commits transactionally to personal storage, while elsewhere it uses its own 27-slot cache. The Treasure Basin inherits the snapshot but has an independent cache. Plain, stabilized, and advanced Miniature Immortal Ruins are not Xianqiao-bound; they operate their own or linked buffers and nearby containers. AE2, RS, and Mekanism integrations use standard capabilities and long-valued resource keys over the same real ledger.
